image_description: A cluster of four brown, arrow-shaped directional street signs mounted on two metal posts against a clear blue sky. The signs feature text in Hebrew, Arabic, and English (e.g., 'Absalom Pillar', 'The Last Path'). A large semi-transparent watermark ('JH') overlays the left side of the image. In the background, there is a road with a car, stone walls, trees, and distant buildings.
